column1: # Real service definitions for Oniomarchy's Trigger > Pentest > Services
# menu. Columns (tab-separated): id<TAB>label<TAB>package<TAB>confirm<TAB>unit1<TAB>unit2
# unit2 is optional (leave blank if the service is a single unit).
# id becomes trigger.pentest.services.<id>[.start|.stop|.restart].
# label is purpose-based (what the service is actually used for on this
# machine), not the raw package/unit name, per user request.
# confirm: yes = gate Start/Restart behind a gum-confirm prompt in a real
#          terminal (CLAUDE.md's confirm-before-enable rule — SSH/RDP open
#          remote-access attack surface); no = silent pkexec action, no
#          terminal, matching trigger.pentest.mac-randomize.
#          Stop never confirms either way.
# verify-units.sh confirms package + each listed unit file actually exist
# (pacman -Q / pacman -Ql) before a row is allowed into the generated menu —
# nothing here is trusted blind.
# samba (SMB Fileserver) and vsftpd (FTP) were removed 2026-08-27 — dropped
# entirely rather than kept as toggleable services, per user decision.
# postgresql was briefly labeled "Metasploit" 2026-08-27, then corrected to
# "Database" the same day: this row only toggles postgresql.service itself,
# not Metasploit (which has no systemd unit — msfconsole is run directly,
# and msfrpcd, its optional RPC daemon, isn't wired up here). Parrot OS's
# own System Services menu keeps these as two separate entries for the same
# reason — see notes/pentest-tools.md / CLAUDE.md if a real Metasploit
# (msfrpcd) toggle gets added later.
# apache/nginx added 2026-08-27, matching Parrot's own System Services menu
# (unit names httpd.service/nginx.service confirmed against Arch's package
# file listings, since neither is installed on this machine).
# beef added 2026-08-27, also matching Parrot. beef-xss ships no systemd
# unit of its own (its docs say to run `sudo beef` directly) — "custom:"
# prefix on a unit means it's authored by this repo (install/services/
# beef.service) and installed by install-scripts.sh, not package-owned;
# verify-units.sh skips the pacman-ownership check for those. beef is
# confirm-gated: it binds 0.0.0.0:3000 with default credentials beef/beef
# out of the box, a comparable exposure to SSH/RDP.
sshd
xrdp
postgresql
apache
